kpis.description_fr: Primes brutes émises 110.3 Mds€ en 2024. AXA = #2 assureur mondial. Mix P&C (Dommages) + Vie/Santé + Asset Mgmt (AXA IM).
kpis.description_en: Gross written premiums €110.3B in 2024. AXA = #2 global insurer. P&C + Life/Health + Asset Mgmt (AXA IM) mix.

kpis.description_en: P&C Combined Ratio 93% in 2024. <100% = technically profitable. Underwriting discipline + pricing actions.

kpis.description_en: Underlying earnings €8.1B in 2024. Key insurer performance indicator, underlying IFRS 17.

kpis.description_en: Solvency II ratio 216% end-2024. Well above 100% regulatory minimum, capital buffer for distributions.
